page.content:
The league's central coast-to-coast argument.

How Celtics–Lakers rivalry connects

  • Faction: Boston Celtics — The Celtics half of the rivalry runs from Russell through Bird and after.
  • Faction: Los Angeles Lakers — The Lakers half of the rivalry runs from the Minneapolis move through Showtime and Kobe.
  • Topic: NBA — The Celtics–Lakers rivalry is the NBA's longest title argument.

What is Celtics–Lakers rivalry?

The Celtics–Lakers rivalry is the NBA's longest title argument: Russell against the Minneapolis-then-Los-Angeles Lakers, Bird against Magic, and later Finals rematches.

Key threads lead to Boston Celtics, Los Angeles Lakers and NBA.
